text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"full-sentence motivational paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its ideas more fully instead of staying at a list-like or fragmentary level."},{"evidence":"clear organizing words like \"Next,\" \"Finally,\" and \"Last,\"","quality":"organization","description":"It uses sequencing cues to guide the reader through the presentation more coherently."},{"evidence":"mostly understandable academic vocabulary like \"graduate high School,\" \"Degree,\" \"classes,\" \"succeed\"","quality":"word choice","description":"It shows a somewhat more purposeful use of topic-appropriate vocabulary."},{"evidence":"extended connected sentences across the essay","quality":"sentence control","description":"It maintains longer stretches of connected writing with fewer breakdowns into run-on fragments than the other essay."},{"evidence":"direct advice to students about goals and effort","quality":"coherence","description":"Its ideas stay more focused on one central message and connect more logically from sentence to sentence."}]}
